script_text: A fire-sign reckoning is coming, Sagittarius — the stars are forcing a confrontation you've been dodging. On Thursday the Sun enters your 11th House of Libra, shifting your energy from career to shared dreams. Venus enters your 11th House Saturday, forming a trine with Jupiter — a golden social and romantic window opens. Weekend leans toward connection over solitude. Thursday is your power day because the Sun enters your 11th House, lighting your fire-sign social vision. Tuesday is your worst day as Mars squares Jupiter, straining your work-home balance. Have an honest conversation with a close friend before Friday — the Libra honesty running through your week demands it. Follow for daily updates.
